paragraphs: Rav Yosef bar Minyomi said in Rav Nachman’s name: Berakhot 23a; Eruvin 45a and 76b; Yevamot 101b and Beit Shammai 107b; Ketubbot 81b, end, and the printed locator קע״ב; Gittin 9a, 45b, 70b; Bava Kamma 97a; Bava Metzia, 16b [printed ט״ז יב׳], 32a, 64b; Bava Batra 132a–b, 148b; Shevuot 47a; Chullin 13b, 46a, 48a. Perhaps Rav Acha bar Minyomi was his brother; and Rav Huna bar Minyomi.
